summary.text: Mike Moore is a Democratic state senator who has represented the 2nd Worcester District since 2009 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Michael Moore earned his bachelor's degree and an M.A. in criminal justice from Western New England College.
In the 2025-2026 session, Moore chairs the Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity and is vice chair of the Financial Services Joint Committee.

His other assignments include the joint committees on Bonding, Capital Expenditures, and State Assets; Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture; Higher Education; Municipalities and Regional Government; and Public Safety and Homeland Security.
